extracted.name: Blueberry cheesecake pancakes
extracted.description: Try these moreish blueberry cheesecake pancakes on Shrove Tuesday, they'll go down a storm with the family. They also make a lovely dessert all year round
ingredient_lines: ½ -1 tbsp icing sugar to taste
4 caramelised biscuits or ginger nuts, crushed
50g nuts (pecans or almonds work well), roughly chopped or crushed (optional)
instruction_lines: Simmer the blueberries and maple syrup over a low heat until soft and syrupy, this should take about 3 mins.
Mix the cream cheese and icing sugar to taste. When the pancakes are cooked, top with blueberries, sweetened cream cheese, crushed biscuits and nuts.
